blocks.text: Event handling and interactivity allow a program to respond to user actions. An event is an action, such as clicking a button or typing text. The program waits for an event instead of running all the time. When an event occurs, a specific task is performed. This makes the application active and useful. Event handling is important in graphical programs. It helps control how the program behaves.
